text: A single-patient clinical vignette described one woman with progressive stiffness, spasms, anti-GAD positivity, and treatment with IVIG and symptomatic therapy.
This conference abstract presented a small descriptive report of stiff-person syndrome cases with very limited clinical detail and no formal cohort design.
This retrospective cohort study reviewed 107 patients with stiff-person spectrum disorder and compared clinical manifestations, antibody findings, and immunotherapy responses.
This retrospective cohort study described 9 stiff-person syndrome cases from Tanzania and reported prevalence and aggregate clinical features.
This small placebo-controlled levetiracetam trial compared intervention and placebo exposure in a stiff-person syndrome series.
